# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc15

This candidate corrects the Achievements tab's sticky-header scope.

- Pins only the two compact progress lines: earned count and due/upcoming count.
- Moves the in-game date and explanatory paragraph into the scrolling achievement content.
- Applies the correction to both rule-based and legacy achievement catalogs.
- Adds a regression check that keeps the two pinned strings separate from scrolling detail.
